constants_widths_pointer_arithmetic.coordinate: mx=origin_x+x and my=origin_y+y in signed 16-bit arithmetic; if signed my>63 then mx+=64 and my&=63. Plane 0/1 then mx&=127; plane 2/3 then mx&=63. Negative my is not normalized by the >63 rule.
constants_widths_pointer_arithmetic.pheromone: For plane 0/1, mode 0..4 selects one unsigned [64][32] table indexed [mx>>1][my>>1]; v>16 sets byte g_94E4=((v>>4)&31)-16 (byte narrowing), otherwise zero. Mode default skips scent decoding. Zero scent falls back to MapA[mx][my].
constants_widths_pointer_arithmetic.life: Life byte 0 returns after tile selection with g_9126 still zero. Plane A: 0xFF uses A+04C2+0x380 plus 0502 when signed 04C2<8 else 0496; 0xFE uses A+0496+04C2+0x388; other nonzero byte uses v+0x100. Planes B/R: 0xFE uses A+0496+04C2+0x308; 0xFF uses A+04C2+0x300 plus 0502 or 0496 under the same signed <8 split; other nonzero byte uses v+0x200. Results narrow/wrap to unsigned 16-bit g_9126.
constants_widths_pointer_arithmetic.table_stride: Source dimensions and original byte addressing agree: PherMap offset=(mx>>1)*32+(my>>1); MapA/LifeA offset=mx*64+my; MapB/R and LifeB/R offset=mx*64+my. Table elements are bytes.

Its localized structural differences are coordinate/local register-home selection (including a candidate BP home for a coordinate) and resultant branch layout; the original keeps mx/my in SI/DI and the source candidate uses different homes. The temporary values and conditions are unchanged, and no private local escapes. No semantic difference is identified. This receipt does not turn the diagnostic into historical byte acceptance.

The targeted diagnostic labels these operand changes LOCAL_CODEGEN_UNCLASSIFIED; they do not change values under the pinned sequential DOS call model, where no call or target-side write interleaves these reads. An asynchronous writer/reentrant call between loads is not proven or claimed.
